fullDescription:
Japan: Procreate Brushes

+ 5 Old paper textures included.
In this set you will get 15 AUTHENTIC Japan inspired brushes and old paper textures for creative projects. You will love to use this brushes in Procreate on any kind of projects, from illustrations for kids, watercolor style illustrations, comic and realistic projects. Also there are included dry brushes for Japan style lettering

To use the brushes simply choose a brush, select the paint tool and draw. The color and width of the strokes can be adjusted easily.

IMPORTANT:

These brushes are ONLY for Procreate and for use with Apple Pencil or compatible stylus.
These brushes DO NOT WORK IN PHOTOSHOP or ILLUSTRATOR.

WHAT IS INCLUDED: .ZIP FILE Japan Procreate Brushes
